parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Let your shoulders drop. <short pause> Let your jaw soften. <short pause> You are held. <long pause> Take a slow breath in... and let it go. <long pause> Another breath... gentle, and easy. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: This day is done. <short pause> Whatever it held... it is finished now. <long pause> And before you rest, you can take a moment to look back. <short pause> Not at everything. Just at three small things. <short pause> Three gifts from this ordinary day. <long pause> Breathe slowly. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Let the first one come to mind. <short pause> Maybe it was something you tasted, or something you heard. <short pause> A kind word... a warm drink... a few minutes of quiet. <long pause> Let it rise gently to the surface. <long pause> And when it does... just say thank you. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Now, a second gift. <short pause> Something small you might have missed. <short pause> A tree you walked past. A door that opened. A moment when your body worked the way it was meant to. <long pause> Let it come. <long pause> And say thank you again. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: One more. <short pause> A third small thing. <short pause> It does not have to be perfect, or big. <short pause> Maybe it was the fact that you made it through. <short pause> Maybe it was a breath of air, or a place to lie down. <long pause> Let it come. <long pause> And offer thanks. <long pause>

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Paul wrote to the church at Thessalonica, with a simple instruction. <long pause>
In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you. <short pause> First Thessalonians, chapter five, verse eighteen. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: In every thing. <short pause> Not for every thing... but in the middle of it. <short pause> Even in the hard days, there are small mercies. <long pause> You have named three tonight. <short pause> Let them rest with you now. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Breathe slowly... and let your body grow heavy. <long pause> You are grateful... and you are loved. <long pause>

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: May you sleep in peace. <long pause>
